svg.text: 4-Register RPN Stack Engine, Dual Stand Modes & Hardware Guide

text.tspan: Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) with 4 registers.
Numbers push onto stack; operators evaluate at once:
Stack Architecture: Registers T, Z, Y, X
Zero parentheses, zero ambiguity, zero errors.

g.text: • Keycaps: 43 sculpted Shore 90A TPU keys over tactile switches
• Stack: Push on [ENTER], pop on op, LastX saved
• Power: USB-C LiPo with <15 µA ultra-low sleep

text.tspan: • Desk Stand: 11.6° forward incline for typing.
• Puzzle Stand: 3-piece easel docks unit at 78°.
Knocks flat to 6mm to slip into travel caddy.

g.text: OPERATING MODES: 11.6° DESK INCLINE & 78° PUZZLE EASEL
TOTAL: Calculator + TPU Sleeve + Puzzle Stand + Desk Caddy + Cable + Box = 6 Parts
• Instant Power Off: Tap [f] then [ON/OFF] to shut down.
• Auto-Sleep Standby: Sleeps after 5 min idle (<15 µA).
• Non-Volatile Memory: Registers (X, Y, Z, T) persist.
• Annunciators: RAD/DEG, [f], [g], battery on OLED header.

text.tspan: Need replacement puzzle stand trusses, a fresh
TPU sleeve, keycaps, or braided USB-C cable?
All physical hardware components are stocked.

g.text: Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts
✓ NO LOOSE BLOCKS — JUST TURN IT OFF!

text.tspan: Unlike manipulative block kits, you don't
need to count or pack up 70 pieces!
Simply press [f] [OFF] to turn off, or let
auto-sleep preserve your stack.
Dock in the Desk Stand or slip into the TPU
sleeve and drop in your backpack.
Your calculation state waits in memory until
your next keystroke!
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step
hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage
arrangements, and calculator cross-references!
Keep this card stored inside the box lid!

g.text: Designed in Mountain View, California, USA • Non-Toxic BPA-Free.

text.tspan: Any algebraic expression can be evaluated unambiguously
without parentheses using a postfix stack.
